kaikki_vikisozluk.e: جِلْبَاب • (jilbāb) m (plural جَلَابِيب (jalābīb))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Ge'ez ግልባብ (gəlbab, “covering, veil, wrapper”) from ገልበበ (gälbäbä, “to cover, to veil, to wrap, to envelop”), whereas the verbs in the Arabic root ج ل ب ب (j l b b) are denominal.
s: ج ل ب ب (j l b b)
g: a long, loose-fitting outer garment; a robe
a woman's long headcloth; a headscarf
